svg.aria-label: Aftershock. Every incident becomes a test. Git history proves it. Aftershock turns a production incident into a regression test that must fail on the commit before the fix and pass on the fix, then guards every pull request against the incident coming back. A sample incident, INC-12, payment retry charged a customer twice: its test fails 3 of 3 runs on commit 3f2a1c9, the commit before the fix, and passes 3 of 3 on the fix aa86f56, so it is proven. Below, a seismograph trace spikes at the incident and settles into a green line once the fix is proven.
